title: Klara and the Sun Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 65
rules: If Klara and the Sun has a Tomatometer score of above 65 on Oct 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: There are no reviews yet. The film premieres at the London Film Festival on Oct 15 and opens in the US on Oct 23, so the Oct 26 score will rest on a fairly full set of reviews. Strong Ishiguro source material and the Amy Adams/Jenna Ortega cast help, but post-production dragged on for two years, it skipped the big fall festivals, early trailer buzz was poor, and Waititi's recent films (Next Goal Wins, Thor 4) scored below 65%. That makes a score above 65 somewhat less likely than not.
blind.falsifier: Strongly positive first reactions and reviews out of the London premiere on Oct 15, pushing the early Tomatometer into the 75%+ range with dozens of reviews.

final.reasoning: The market's 36.5% midpoint is almost the same as my independent 38%, so the price doesn't change my view and leaves no real edge. With premiere reviews not yet out, a 1.5-point gap isn't enough to bet on.
